result.topic_en: Bare calculations of definite integrals in a parameter s (with semi-axis parameters a, b, c expressed through epsilon, h, m), their evaluation in terms of pi, a differential relation of the form dx/x + dy/y + dz/z = 0 obtained from log differences, and reduction of an integral f(alpha) via the substitution with tan/sin phi to trigonometric expressions in phi, apparently for the rotating fluid ellipsoid problem.
